settings.title: Does it really work for my skin tone?
settings.content: Yes — Vera Lane Tone-Adapting Foundation uses encapsulated micro-pigments that release based on your skin's natural undertone, temperature, and pH. One shade truly matches fair through deep skin, including olive and yellow undertones that traditionally oxidise.

settings.title: How long does the colour change take?
settings.content: Under 30 seconds from application. Dot it, blend it, and watch the pigment lock to your skin within half a minute. No waiting, no streaking.

settings.title: Is this safe for sensitive or rosacea-prone skin?
settings.content: Yes — the formula is fragrance-free, dermatologist-tested, and non-comedogenic. It contains niacinamide and centella asiatica to actively calm redness and reactive skin.

settings.title: How does the 30-day guarantee work?
settings.content: Try Vera Lane for 30 days. If you're not in love with how it makes you look, email us and we'll refund every dollar — no questions, no return shipping costs. Bottle stays with you.

settings.question: Does it REALLY change colour to match my skin?
settings.answer: Yes. The micro-encapsulated pigments in Vera Lane release in response to your skin's natural undertone, pH, and warmth. Within 30 seconds it locks to a custom match that no off-the-shelf shade can replicate.

settings.question: How is this different from cheap colour-changing foundations on TikTok?
settings.answer: Cheaper formulas use a single oxidising pigment that turns orange the moment it warms up. Vera Lane uses a stabilised, dermatologist-developed pigment matrix that holds its match for 12+ hours without oxidation.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive or rosacea-prone skin?
settings.answer: Yes. The formula is fragrance-free, dermatologist-tested, and built around niacinamide and centella asiatica — two of the most-cited actives for calming reactive skin.

settings.question: Is this suitable for mature skin over 50?
settings.answer: It's specifically designed for it. The hydrating serum base prevents settling into fine lines, and the soft-focus finish blurs texture without caking.

settings.question: What if the coverage isn't enough?
settings.answer: Layer it. Vera Lane is buildable — one layer gives skin-like coverage, two layers gives a full, photographic finish without thickness.

settings.question: Will it turn orange during the day?
settings.answer: No. Our pigment system is oxidation-stable, so the shade you blend in at 7am is the same shade you'll see at 7pm.

settings.question: Do I need a primer?
settings.answer: No. The hydrating base prepares the skin as it goes on. Most customers skip primer entirely.

settings.question: How does the 30-day money-back guarantee work?
settings.answer: Use the bottle. If you're not in love with how it makes you look, email us within 30 days and we'll refund every dollar. No need to ship the bottle back.
